name: VR NeRF Rendering Configuration
definition: Configuration for rendering room-scale NeRF models in VR, targeting native rendering on Meta Quest Pro with high resolution, high frame rates, and low latency.
summary: VR NeRF Rendering Configuration defines hyperparameters for training and rendering room-scale Neural Radiance Fields on Meta Quest Pro, distinguishing itself by targeting iNGP-style hash grid networks optimized for high-resolution, low-latency VR hardware.
